description: Claim a path before editing it, so parallel agent sessions do not overwrite each other. ok false names the session that holds it; then work on something else or wait. A claim lasts 24 hours; claim again to renew.

path.description: The file or directory path, relative to the repository root.

team.description: A name only your agents know, e.g. your repo plus a random word; claims are seen only within it.

name: claim
